selfContainmentPolicy.rule: Every rendered question must display all variables required to solve the CP. Runtime may only substitute approved placeholders.

entries.text: Find the LCM of {numbers}.
Find the least common multiple of {numbers}.
What is the least number that is exactly divisible by {numbers}?
Determine the smallest positive number divisible by {numbers}.
Calculate the LCM of {numbers}.
Three bells ring at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they ring together now, after how many minutes will they ring together again?
Three lights blink after every {cycleLengths}. If they blink together now, after how much time will they blink together again?
Three alarms ring after every {cycleLengths}. If they ring together now, after how much time will they ring together again?
Three runners complete one round in {cycleLengths}. If they start together, after how much time will they be together at the starting point again?
Three machines complete one cycle in {cycleLengths}. If they start together, after how much time will they complete a cycle together again?
Three buses leave a station at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they leave together now, after how much time will they leave together again?
Three trains arrive at a platform at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they arrive together now, after how much time will they arrive together again?
Three traffic signals change at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they change together now, after how much time will they change together again?
Three sprinklers operate at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they start together now, after how much time will they operate together again?
Three maintenance schedules repeat at intervals of {cycleLengths}. If they occur together now, after how much time will they occur together again?
The LCM of {knownNumbers} and a number x is {targetLcm}. If x belongs to {candidateSet}, find x.
The LCM of {knownNumbers} and x is {targetLcm}. If x lies between {lowerBound} and {upperBound}, find x.
The LCM of {knownNumbers} and x is {targetLcm}. If x is divisible by {divisor}, find x.
The LCM of {knownNumbers} and x is {targetLcm}. If x is an even number less than {upperBound}, find x.
